|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|

| **Thai Basil** | 2001 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60614 | (312) 555‑5678 | Offers a “Vegetarian” section on the main menu; tofu pad seeu, vegetable curry, and fresh spring rolls. |

| **Tasty Thai** | 1500 W Belmont Ave, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑3456 | Provides vegetarian options like tofu pad kee mao, vegetable khao soi, and a vegetarian soup line. |
